newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat ends lower, March weak on hedging.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat ends lower, March weak on hedging.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures ended lower on extremely light volumes, with front-month March under pressure from hedge-related selling, traders said.
"There were no major players. The locals were the only ones in there," a floor source said.
MGE spring wheat closed 3-3/4 to 5-3/4 cents per bushel lower, with March down 4-3/4 cents at $3.87-3/4.
"We've seen a little hedging tied to some movement out in the country, but we're down more than anything else on spillover pressure from Kansas City," a MGE trader said at the midsession.
U.S. wheat markets were generally lower on a lack of news and softness in world wheat values.
Country Hedging sold 500,000 March bushels, traders said. LFG bought 400,000 March and sold 200,000 March.
MGE barley futures closed unchanged to six cents per cwt lower, with May down six cents at $6.70.
